string.text: Hold a key over an inventory cell to drop, disassemble, transfer, or strip. Moving to a new cell acts on that item. Inventory sort will not chain into whatever slides under the cursor.
Hold to disassemble the item under the cursor. Moving to a new cell disassembles that item too. Only while inventory or loot is open.
Hold for (sec) to do whole stack
After this many seconds on the same cell, the rest of that stack is disassembled. 0 = rest of the stack right after the first item.
Grant unread stash coords when disassembling PDAs. Double tool wear if a coord is found, triple if the PDA was encrypted. Shows a lock icon on encrypted PDAs.
When GAMMA wants a tool type, wear the lowest-condition stack of that type that will still survive (including drag-and-drop). Does not change which tool type is required.
Scrap detached scopes, silencers, launchers, and tac kits into craft parts.
After disassemble, post the parts you get on the PDA ticker. Off by default.
Hold to drop the item under the cursor. Moving to a new cell drops that item too. Only while inventory or loot is open.
Hold for (sec) to do whole stack
After this many seconds on the same cell, the rest of that stack is dropped. 0 = rest of the stack right after the first item.
Hold to transfer the item under the cursor (loot and trade). Moving to a new cell transfers that item too, including rows in the stack popup. Replaces GAMMA Fast Transfer. Default Left Shift.
Hover a weapon and strip its attachments and parts. Hold mode strips each newly hovered weapon. Works in the stack popup.
When you disassemble a weapon that still has attachments or parts, it strips those instead. Once nothing is left to strip, disassemble works normally.
Move stripped attachments and parts back to the weapon's inventory.
Prevent moving equipped items (PDA, NVG, etc.) into a companion inventory - some can vanish. Loose bag items still move normally.
